properties.description:
Make review and observation work with actual results rather than sample content.

Scope

• Reuse session/turn-range, current diff, captured snapshot and check-run evidence.

• Review ordinary tasks against definitions/results or exact code snapshots; support blocked/revise/approve/abandon outcomes.

• Keep reviewed scope frozen, block dependants and preserve independent work choices.

• Project automatic/semantic/deterministic requirements and author-owned comment closure into a unified review check collection; requirement provenance and submitted revision are retained.

• Build on the basic gate enforcement delivered in T01/T02 for R02; integrate richer file/session/check evidence and unified presentation without creating a second owner.

• Detect/aggregate existing repository-owned checks and wire one granular run-checks operation through shared UI/MCP; attach existing coverage/report evidence without building the shared-check framework.

• Adapt freshness gates so the human can explicitly accept an earlier passed run for the selected revision; show both the mismatch and acceptance, never a fabricated fresh pass.

• Wire header run-all/mandatory/selected and scoped cancellation to the shared check owner; preserve partial evidence and distinguish unsupported cancellation.

Success criteria

1. Planning-only review does not require a fake Git diff or code checks.

2. Code review shows the exact submitted revision and run provenance. Stale results are flagged and block passage unless the human records target-specific acceptance of earlier passed evidence; changed snapshot identity is never silently substituted.

3. All comments must close and all required reviewers approve; generic edits cannot bypass gates.

4. Sessions may span attempts via turn ranges; evidence links open the correct existing viewer.

5. Shared checkout limits are visible, without falsely promising automatic parallel isolation.

6. Reviewer decisions and comment/input closure derive from their owners. Generic metadata changes cannot manufacture passage; open comments remain blocking. Stale passed evidence can be accepted only by an explicit human decision bound to the target revision.

7. One run-checks call resolves repository-owned applicable checks at the requested granularity and aggregates their results without requiring the agent to choose individual commands.

8. Execution record distinguishes selected/run/skipped/not-run checks, versions and when each ran. Later changes preserve the old result and reveal the mismatch.

9. Coverage exposes measured result and effective threshold with available scope/provenance. No line/file/function coverage explorer, shared pipeline engine or agent-review harness is required.

10. All/mandatory/selected deduplicate runnable targets and never invoke reviewer/closure rows. Stop records affected run IDs and observed cancellation/partial results; cancelled/missing evidence never becomes mandatory pass.

11. Latest nested check evidence and chronological run events reference the same stored execution; neither rewrites policy or hides stale results.

12. Failed-R02 replacement scenario passes end to end, including required-actor finish boundary, overlapping freeze protection, unresolved comment carry-forward and no generic-unlink gate bypass.

Evidence

• Review/evidence integration tests

• Blocked-dependant and snapshot mismatch demonstrations
properties.title: Connect real evidence and review gates
